name: diagnose-animal
description: Investigate a single Animal entity for anomalies

arguments.key: Entity URN (e.g. urn:ngsi-ld:Animal:cow001), or legalId, or name

resolve: the entity URN is the only primary key; legalId and name are secondary and must be resolved to an id first
if key starts with urn:ngsi-ld:Animal: use it as the id
count the entities returned, not pagination.total
no match: say so, do not guess a similar key
more than one match (names need not be unique): list id, name, legalId, species, locatedAt and ask which one
exceptions: reproductiveCondition of noStatus is not a flag when phenologicalCondition is grazingBaby or lactatingBaby
healthCondition or welfareCondition not stored: report 'no data', not healthy or adequate

phrasing.locatedAt: barn placement while the rest of the herd is on pasture
phrasing.weight: weight deviating from the animal's own history (a sustained fall, or no gain while still young)

template: Investigate the animal with key {{key}} (type Animal). The key is case-sensitive; use it exactly as given. First resolve it to an id: {{resolve}}. Then call get_entity with neighbourhood=true, limit=5 and no pick, then get_entity_history for {{trendCheck}}. Inspect {{inspect}}. Cross-reference relationships: {{relationships}} and the neighbourhood siblings. Flag anomalies: {{phrasing}}, applying exceptions: {{exceptions}}. Report findings and the most likely explanation.
